Description: Single-row pin header, 2.54mm pitch, vertical, through-hole; two headers form the 2x8 socket for the ESP32-C3 Super Mini (15.24mm row spacing)
Notes: Body ~20.3 x 2.54mm per header; 2.54mm pitch; use female socket headers so the Super Mini plugs in; J1 = 5V/GND/3V3/GPIO4/3/2/1/0, J2 = GPIO5/6/7/8/9/10/20/21 (per board silkscreen); v5 layout: headers horizontal, J1 upper, J2 lower, left side

Description: 7-channel Darlington transistor array, 50V / 500mA per channel, with integrated freewheeling diodes; INVERTS (GPIO high = relay ON)
Notes: Body 3.9 x 9.9mm, 1.27mm pitch; v5 uses ONLY ch 1 (IN1/OUT1, pins 1/16) -> K1; ch 7 (IN7/OUT7, pins 7/10) unpopulated (relay 2 removed); pin 8 = GND, pin 9 = COM must connect to +12V so the kickback diodes can clamp relay coil flyback (12V relays since v3.4)

Coil 12V, 400 ohm +/-10%, ~30mA (~360mW); contacts 10A 250VAC / 10A 30VDC; body ~19 x 15.5 x 15.5mm (verify against datasheet); NO/NC pin assignment must be verified with a multimeter before mains use (see notes); single relay in v5 (K2/J6 removed per user 2026-11-16)

TO-220; pinout 1=IN, 2=GND, 3=OUT; dropout ~2V (needs >= ~7V in for 5V out); feeds only the Super Mini + WS2812 (relay coil runs off 12V since v3.4); at ~150-250mA load from 12V it dissipates ~1-1.4W - no heatsink needed at this load, keep some airflow / copper around it

column8: No 6.5x5.5 model in the KiCad library; CP_Elec_6.3x5.3 is the closest (pads identical to 6.3x5.4, centres +/-2.8mm); the 6.5mm can solders straight onto the 6.3 footprint, overhanging each pad edge by 0.1mm; C1 = 12V input filter, C3 = 5V output filter; POLARIZED - observe + marking, reversed polarity will damage the capacitor

Notes: 0805 (2.0 x 1.25mm); C2 = 12V bypass, C4 = 5V bypass; non-polarized; X7R dielectric or better
